model: Symo / Primo / Galvo / Symo Hybrid via Datamanager (SunSpec int+SF)
applies_to: Fronius inverters read through a Fronius Datamanager (1.0/2.0 card or Hybridmanager) with SunSpec Model Type set to int+SF; model 124 present on Symo Hybrid.
summary: The Fronius Datamanager publishes each connected inverter as a SunSpec device (unit ID = inverter number) over Modbus TCP, and over RTU on Datamanager 2.0. With the int+SF model type the inverter model is 101/102/103 followed by nameplate, settings, status, immediate controls, multiple-MPPT and storage models. This map covers the 16-bit measurements, state, ratings and every writable control register.

addressing.note: Fronius numbers registers from 1 (SunSpec base register 40001) and says to send the register number minus one: register 40001 is requested at address 40000 (0x9C40). The manual's RTU example reads register 40005 with address bytes 9C 44. Fronius registers 212-217 follow the same rule (212 -> 211).

firmware: Register map archive version 1.1.7-0 (int+SF map with Symo Hybrid model 124); manual 42,0410,2049 rev. 033-24022026.

source.title: Fronius Datamanager Modbus TCP & RTU (operating instructions) + Inverter_Register_Map_Int&SF_v1.0_with_SYMOHYBRID_MODEL_124.xlsx
source.pages: PDF English part pp. 62-92 (addressing p. 67-69, unavailable values p. 70, scale factors p. 72-73, settings p. 74-78, models p. 79-92); register table = XLSX sheet 'Complete Map' in https://www.fronius.com/en/~/downloads/Solar%20Energy/Operating%20Instructions/SE_EI_Modbus_Sunspec_Maps_State_Codes_Events_EN.zip

notes: Register table comes from Fronius' official XLSX in the 'Modbus Sunspec Maps, State Codes and Events' ZIP (same download page as the PDF); behaviour and settings come from the PDF.

All addresses here assume SunSpec Model Type = int+SF. With the default float setting the inverter model is 111-113 and every later model starts 10 registers higher (e.g. nameplate 40131 instead of 40121).
Fronius warns the map is dynamic: the correct method is to walk the SunSpec model chain from 40001 (ID, L) and use offsets. The fixed addresses below are the published layout for a single inverter.

Word order: neither the PDF nor the XLSX states the order of 32/64-bit values, so every 32/64-bit register is left out: SID 40001-40002, WH lifetime energy 40094-40095, Evt1/Evt2/EvtVnd1-4 40110-40121, ActWh 40187-40190, StActCtl 40217-40218, Tms 40223-40224, model 160 Evt/DCWH/Tms, and site totals F_Site_Power/Energy 500-513. The SID is documented as 0x53756E53 'SunS', which suggests high word first, but this is not stated.
Registers marked 'Not supported' in the XLSX are left out (temperatures, VMax/VMin, quadrant 2/3 ratings, ride-through, Ris, StorAval, InBatV, and similar).

Unsupported values read as: int16 0x8000, uint16/enum16/bitfield16 0xFFFF, sunssf 0x8000. Some 'supported' points also return these, e.g. phase B/C on single-phase inverters, DCA/DCV on multi-input inverters (use model 160).
The XLSX notes that WH (lifetime energy) may be imprecise; ActWh in model 122 is the alternative (both 32/64-bit, omitted here).

Access is taken from the XLSX R/W column. VAMax (40157) and WMaxLimPct_RmpTms (40236) are marked RW but list only function code 0x03; the PDF says writes to unsupported RmpTms are ignored (ramp supported from Datamanager 3.13.3-2 / Hybridmanager 1.11.3-2).
Model 124 (storage) is only meaningful on Fronius Symo Hybrid with battery.
The PDF describes PVConn bit 1 as 'responsive'; the XLSX calls it 'Available'. The XLSX wording is used.
Energy meters (Fronius Smart Meter) are published at unit ID 240-244 with their own common block and meter model 201-203 starting again at 40001; they are not part of this inverter map.

integration.summary: Enable 'Data output via Modbus' = tcp in the Datamanager web UI, choose SunSpec Model Type int+SF, and poll unit ID = inverter number (inverter 00 = 100) on port 502. Read registers 40070-40109 (wire addresses 40069-40108) in one request and scale each value with its _SF register.

minimum_registers.why: Inverter model ID (101/102/103) - confirms int+SF layout

integration.enable: Datamanager web interface > Settings > Modbus: set 'Data output via Modbus' to tcp (or rtu on Datamanager 2.0, factory default rtu there), pick SunSpec Model Type int+SF, and tick 'Inverter control via Modbus' to allow writes to models 123/124. 'Limit control' can restrict write access to listed IP addresses. Turning Modbus output off cancels any active Modbus control commands.
integration.watchdog: Each control in model 123 has a *_RvrtTms fallback timer (0-28800 s) that restarts with every Modbus message received; when it expires the control ends and the next-priority control (e.g. dynamic power reduction) takes over. RvrtTms = 0 (default) means the setting stays until disabled.
quirks: Off-by-one: tables print SunSpec register numbers from 40001; request number minus one (40001 -> 40000).
Changing int+SF/float (web UI or F_ModelType 216) shifts every model after the inverter model by 10 registers; F_ModelType needs the value 6 written immediately after, or it reverts.
Scale factors are not fixed even if a value is listed - read them; they can change with firmware.
Writes to read-only or unsupported registers are silently ignored (no exception); invalid values return exception 3.
Power factor sign follows EEI: negative when over-excited (Q1), positive when under-excited (Q4).
setup: Unit ID = inverter number set on the inverter display; inverter number 00 maps to unit ID 100. String Controls start at the String Control offset (default 101); Smart Meters at 240-244; Sensor Cards at 245-247.
TCP port defaults to 502 (port 80 not allowed).
RTU is only on Datamanager 2.0 and cannot be used when a Modbus energy meter is configured; baud and parity are set in the web UI. The Datamanager has no bias resistors.
Demo mode in the web UI returns fixed data for commissioning a master without live inverters.
gotchas: Use a response timeout of at least 10 s with several inverters on Solar Net, query sequentially, and keep to 6 inverters per Datamanager.
To change an active power limit, write the new WMaxLimPct and then re-write WMaxLim_Ena = 1; all five registers 40233-40237 may be written in one FC16 request.
Event flags can stay latched; write 0xFFFF to F_Reset_All_Event_Flags (215) to clear them.
